name: Rust Hauler Drone
languages: understands the Authority dialect but cannot speak

traits.name: Corroded Frame
traits.description: Takes 1d6 extra damage from acid or saltwater.

traits.name: Haul Protocol
traits.description: Advantage on grapple checks against anything carrying cargo.

actions.name: Cargo Net (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: DC 14 Dex save or restrained until freed.

flavor: A cargo-hauler drone that outlived its programming and now collects whatever it can lift.
designNotes: Good first-tier boss when a party enters the Rustyard.

name: Glimmer Eel

traits.name: Bait Lantern
traits.description: Lure glows; creatures within 30 ft. must pass DC 12 Wis or approach it.

actions.name: Shock (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: 10-ft. line, DC 13 Con, 4d6 lightning, half on success.

flavor: Its lantern is the last thing many divers see.

name: Barnacle Sentinel

traits.name: Anchored
traits.description: Does not move on its own while anchored; reach 10 ft.

traits.name: Barnacle Crust
traits.description: Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.

actions.name: Release Spores (1/day)
actions.description: 15-ft. cone, DC 13 Con or poisoned 1 min.

flavor: It looks like a rock until it opens.

name: Lantern Swarm

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: Occupies another creature's space and can move through openings 1 inch wide.

traits.name: Dazzling Flash
traits.description: Creatures within 5 ft. must pass DC 11 Con or be blinded until the start of their next turn.

actions.name: Stings
actions.description: +4, 2d6 piercing; 1d6 if half HP or fewer.

flavor: A cloud of lamps, each hungry.

name: The Tunnel Maw

traits.name: Swallow
traits.description: If the maw hits with its bite, the target is grappled and swallowed (DC 16 escape).

traits.name: Echoless
traits.description: Dampens sound within 60 ft.; sonic spells fail.

flavor: An old drainage tunnel that learned to swallow things whole.
designNotes: A set-piece boss for a collapsed tram line.

actions.name: Harvest
actions.description: If grappled target is restrained, deals 2d6 automatic slashing at the start of its turn.

name: The Pale Listener

traits.name: Hum
traits.description: Creatures within 30 ft. have disadvantage on Stealth checks and Concentration saves.

traits.name: Echo
traits.description: Reaction: copies a sound; the Choir believes it speaks.

actions.name: Whisper (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: 60-ft. cone, DC 15 Wis, 6d8 psychic, half on success.

flavor: The Choir's god, or something that listens to it.

name: Cable Siren

traits.name: Live Wire Hair
traits.description: Creatures that touch her take 1d6 lightning.

traits.name: Siren Song
traits.description: Charm DC 14 Wis on listeners within 60 ft.

flavor: A diver who wired herself into the cables.

traits.name: Armored
traits.description: Resistance to nonmagical damage while curled.

actions.name: Roll Over (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Moves up to 30 ft., DC 14 Str or prone and 3d8 bludgeoning.
